descriptions.w3d_registry_80368bd8_unlink: Removes an object from the registry list at 0x80368bd8 and decrements the live count.
descriptions.w3d_registry_80368bd8_create: Allocates and constructs an 84-byte object, links it into the registry list at 0x80368bd8 and counts it.
descriptions.w3d_registry_80368bd8_release: Drops one reference; at zero unlinks and destroys the object, returning the remaining count.
descriptions.w3d_registry_80368bd8_retain: Adds one reference and returns the previous reference count.
